evidence.quote: July 27 (Reuters) - Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.
evidence.one_line: Reuters于2026年7月27日报道，援引《华尔街日报》称，英伟达正与OpenAI洽谈为其数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
evidence.one_line: Reuters援引《华尔街日报》称，约2500亿美元担保涉及数据中心租赁和债务融资、不包括中心内的英伟达芯片；英伟达还在讨论为OpenAI最高3500亿美元的芯片采购提供融资。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: Nvidia and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment.

members.question: 截至2027-01-26，英伟达是否已为OpenAI数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保？

evidence.quote: July 27 (Reuters) - Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.

The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
Nvidia and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment.
